summary: Iteration 45 re-test of the two HIGH issues from iteration 44 plus its LOW items. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration45_usd_forced.py (checkout forced-USD, PayPal amount, door-takings USD conversion, settlement paid->recovered, credit/referral, walk-in validation, pass redeem/double-redeem, membership refund guard, all admin money endpoints). Frontend: Playwright as member, partner and admin covering checkout (USD/INR/AED display), partner Revenue & payouts door-takings, admin money tabs, vendor agreement commercial terms + settlements, member orders + cancellation sheet, wallet/referrals. FIX 1, FIX 2, FIX 3 and the credit/referral conversion are all verified working. FIX 4 is only partially done: no hardcoded rupee glyph remains, but three money screens still mislabel currency (details below). The reported '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' React warning could NOT be reproduced on any page tested - console was clean everywhere. PayPal orders were created only, never approved. All test data removed (door orders 0, TEST45 orders/events/settlements 0, member pending orders 0).

minor.issue: totals.due/batched/paid/commission sum `net` across settlements whose currency differs (USD, AED, INR rows all present) and the response carries no `currency` field, so the UI cannot label them. Same anti-pattern that was just fixed in /api/partner/door-takings: convert each row to BASE_CURRENCY before summing and return currency='USD'.

Row `currency` is either absent or ignored by the client, so the vendor screen prints every row with $ (an AED 25.50 door sale shows as $25.50 and a historical INR 3,066.11 settlement as $3,066.11). Return an explicit per-row currency plus base-converted totals.

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded INR special case: `o.currency !== 'INR' ? `${o.currency} ${charge_total}` : money(o.total)`. Result: a historical INR order renders as '$1,591.94' on the list while its own cancellation sheet correctly says '₹1,592' (83x overstated, contradicting screens), and USD orders render as 'USD 1.00' instead of '$1.00'. Fix: money(o.charge_total ?? o.total, o.currency).

Stat cards read 'DUE INR -10.65 / IN A BATCH INR 1,900.00 / PAID INR 3,200.00 / COMMISSION EARNED INR 1,284.65' on a USD-based product. Local helper `const money = (v, c = 'INR')` defaults to INR and the backend totals have no currency. The very same settlement rows are printed with $ on the vendor's own screen.

All rows and the SETTLED/PENDING cards are printed as $ regardless of row currency (AED 25.50 -> $25.50, INR 3,066.11 -> $3,066.11), so 'PENDING $1,889.35' is a mixed-currency sum. Contradicts the admin screen for the same data.

Credit toggle sub-line shows '₹497 applied · ₹840 left in your wallet' (display currency) directly under 'Buddilio credit − $5.96' (charge currency) in the same card - two symbols for the same number.

ui_bugs.component: INR defaults still seeded in forms
ui_bugs.issue: price_currency defaults to 'INR' in Partner.jsx event form and AdminForms.jsx event form; AgreementsAdmin.jsx blank agreement uses currency 'INR' with INR-sized defaults vendor_net_rate 1500 / pricing_floor 1500; Places.jsx blank country currency 'INR'; MyLedger.jsx and Cancellations.jsx fall back to 'INR' when order.currency is missing. On a USD-base product these should default to USD / BASE_CURRENCY.

issues: Verified fixed: door stat cards now $16.95 / $5.08 / $0.00 in USD alongside the $ payout cards, while table rows keep AED 25.50 and $10.00 - reads correctly

design_issues.screen: Admin > Vendor settlements vs Vendor portal > Settlements
issues: The same five settlement rows are labelled INR on the admin screen and $ on the vendor screen

action_items: Dashboard.jsx My orders: drop the hardcoded 'INR' branch and use money(o.charge_total ?? o.total, o.currency) so historical INR orders keep ₹ and USD orders show $.

vendor_routes.settlement_totals: convert each settlement's net/commission/platform_fee to BASE_CURRENCY before summing and return currency='USD'; remove the `c = 'INR'` default from VendorPayouts.jsx money().
VendorAgreement.jsx Settlements tab: format each row with its own currency and show base-converted totals (currently everything is stamped $).
Replace remaining 'INR' defaults/fallbacks (Partner.jsx, AdminForms.jsx, AgreementsAdmin.jsx incl. 1500 net-rate/floor defaults, Places.jsx, MyLedger.jsx, Cancellations.jsx) with BASE_CURRENCY.
Show credit applied / wallet remaining in the charge currency on the checkout card, or label the display-currency figures explicitly.

Data repair: event 'Sunday Brunch & Board Games' (6a7b6458314aa84df39b86ed) has participant_count = -30 while only 6 confirmed participants exist (pre-existing, from earlier cleanup runs). Recompute from event_participants and clamp the $inc at 0 in the cancel/refund paths.
critical_code_review_comments: checkout() now forces currency = BASE_CURRENCY, which makes the `price_overrides` branch (`if override and currency != BASE_CURRENCY`) dead code - an organiser's exact AED/SGD price is no longer honoured, only the converted base amount (verified: AED 200 event charges $54.50). Confirm this is intended and delete the dead branch, or key the override off the item's price_currency.

Multi-currency aggregation is still unfixed in two places outside door-takings (vendor_routes.settlement_totals and the vendor settlements UI). A shared to_base()/money(row.currency) helper should be used everywhere money is summed.
server.py is still ~8,750 lines; the currency/pricing helpers (BASE_CURRENCY, fx_rates, price_event, tax_for, checkout) belong in a pricing module.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (FIX 1/2/3 + credit/wallet verified; 3 currency-labelling screens still wrong)

All deleted - verified: door orders 0, TEST45 orders/events 0, TEST45 settlements 0, member pending orders 0.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration45_usd_forced.py -n 0` - it self-cleans in test_zz_cleanup and asserts no TEST45 leftovers. Use /app/backend/tests/door_seed45.py --seed / --clean for a UI-visible pair of door sales (one AED, one USD; expected totals collected $16.95 / owed $5.08). Verified this iteration: checkout ignores the display currency (USD/INR/AED all produce the identical USD order, tax GST 16%, gateway stripe, PayPal amount == charge_total), door-takings totals are USD with per-row currency preserved, checkout shows a static 'Billed in USD' label with an FX hint only for non-USD display, wallet reads $10.08 and referral reward $3.00, credit maths ($6.00 + $0.96 tax - $5.96 credit = $1.00) is correct. The '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' React warning did NOT appear on login, dashboard, checkout, wallet, orders, referrals, all 6 partner tabs, 11 admin tabs or the vendor agreement page - treat as not reproducible. Remaining currency-label defects are in Dashboard.jsx My orders, Admin>Vendor settlements cards and VendorAgreement Settlements tab.
rca_of_the_issue: Both HIGH issues from iteration 44 are genuinely fixed: checkout() sets currency = BASE_CURRENCY and derives tax from that fixed currency, so the header picker can no longer change the charged amount, tax jurisdiction or gateway; partner_door_takings() now divides every row by its fx rate before summing and reports currency = BASE_CURRENCY while keeping row.currency for the table. The residual problems are the same anti-pattern in code paths the fix did not touch: (a) vendor_routes.settlement_totals sums mixed-currency `net` values and returns no currency, and VendorPayouts.jsx defaults its money() helper to 'INR'; (b) VendorAgreement.jsx formats every settlement row with the base symbol regardless of row currency; (c) Dashboard.jsx's My orders row keeps an explicit `!== 'INR'` branch that routes INR orders through money() with the base currency, printing historical ₹ amounts with a $ sign.
